description:
Home screen launcher for D-pad and T9 keypad phones
Launcher on 9 keys. A home screen for phones with a physical keypad and no touchscreen: number
keys launch your apps, the d-pad moves the selection.

Features:

* App slots 1-9, each launched directly by its number key
* Browse every installed app with T9 search
* Left/Right as two more shortcuts to apps of your choice
* Speed dial: hold a digit and press Call to call an assigned contact
* Today's and tomorrow's calendar entries above the app list
* A notification indicator and a low-battery warning
* Reorder, rename and reassign slots from the keypad
* Import and export all settings as a single file
* An in-app manual covering every key

No internet permission, no ads, no analytics, no third-party libraries. Everything stays on the
device.

Part of Nine, a suite of apps for keypad phones: https://nine.furrer.life
